slides.title: Which Southeast Asian market first?
slides.subtitle: Market-entry recommendation · hypothetical company, real World Bank data
slides.notes: The company is invented; every market statistic is public and cited.

slides.title: Launch in Indonesia first, and let a six-week paid test confirm it before full spend
points: Indonesia is the largest reachable market: 206M internet users, 2.4 times Vietnam's
Adjusted for income, Indonesia's online market is at least twice that of any other candidate
Vietnam is the best backup: the fastest-growing economy, but under half Indonesia's online audience
Whether we can win is unproven in every market, so a six-week paid test should gate the full launch
slides.notes: The answer, then the four reasons.

slides.title: Indonesia has 206M internet users, 2.4 times Vietnam's and over 3 times Thailand's

ghost.exhibit: bar — internet users by country, 2024, millions (Indonesia highlighted)
evidence: E1 Population 2024: Indonesia 283.5M, Vietnam 101.0M, Philippines 115.8M, Thailand 71.7M [SRC 1]
E2 Individuals using the internet, % of population, 2024: Indonesia 72.8, Vietnam 84.2, Philippines 67.3, Thailand 90.9 [SRC 2]
E3 Internet users 2024: Indonesia 206.3M, Vietnam 85.0M, Philippines 77.9M, Thailand 65.1M [CALC]
E4 Indonesia's internet users vs others: 2.43× Vietnam, 2.65× Philippines, 3.17× Thailand [CALC]

slides.notes: Internet users = population × share using the internet.

slides.title: Indonesia also added the most users since 2019 (+76M) and still has 77M people offline

ghost.exhibit: stacked bar — population online vs offline by country, 2024, millions
evidence: E5 Internet users 2019: Indonesia 130.0M, Vietnam 66.7M, Philippines 47.7M, Thailand 47.7M [CALC]
E6 Internet users added 2019-2024: Indonesia +76.4M, Philippines +30.2M, Vietnam +18.3M, Thailand +17.5M [CALC]
E7 Offline population 2024: Indonesia 77.2M, Philippines 37.9M, Vietnam 16.0M, Thailand 6.5M [CALC]

slides.notes: Room to grow: Vietnam and Thailand are already mostly online.

slides.title: Income per person in Indonesia matches Vietnam's and trails only Thailand's

ghost.exhibit: bar — GDP per capita, PPP, 2024, current international $
evidence: E8 GDP per capita, PPP, current international $: 2024 Thailand 24,909, Indonesia 16,472, Vietnam 16,388, Philippines 11,814… [SRC 3]

slides.notes: In 2025 Vietnam edges ahead (18.1k vs 17.7k); the two remain close.

slides.title: Adjusted for income, Indonesia's online market is at least twice that of any other candidate

ghost.exhibit: bar — internet users × GDP per capita (PPP), 2024, international $ trillion
evidence: E9 Online purchasing-power proxy 2024 (internet users × GDP per capita PPP), international $ trillion: Indonesia 3.40, Thailand 1.62, Vietnam 1.39… [CALC]
E10 Indonesia's proxy vs others: 2.10× Thailand, 2.45× Vietnam, 3.70× Philippines [CALC]

slides.notes: A rough proxy (assumption 2), used only to rank, not to size revenue.

slides.title: Vietnam is the best backup: the fastest-growing economy, but under half Indonesia's online audience

ghost.exhibit: highlight table — GDP growth 2025, average GDP growth 2021-2025, income growth 2019-2025, internet users 2024, by country
evidence: E11 Real GDP growth 2025: Vietnam 8.0%, Indonesia 5.1%, Philippines 4.4%, Thailand 2.4%… [SRC 4]
E12 GDP per capita PPP growth 2019-2025: Vietnam +64%, Indonesia +47%, Philippines +41%, Thailand +31% [CALC]
E13 Vietnam's internet users as share of Indonesia's: 41% [CALC]

slides.notes: If the Indonesia test fails, Vietnam is next.

slides.title: Thailand is small and slow-growing, and the Philippines has the lowest income of the four

ghost.exhibit: two columns — Thailand (fewest internet users, slowest growth) vs Philippines (lowest income per person)
evidence: E3 Internet users 2024: Indonesia 206.3M, Vietnam 85.0M, Philippines 77.9M, Thailand 65.1M [CALC]
E8 GDP per capita, PPP, current international $: 2024 Thailand 24,909, Indonesia 16,472, Vietnam 16,388, Philippines 11,814… [SRC 3]
E11 Real GDP growth 2025: Vietnam 8.0%, Indonesia 5.1%, Philippines 4.4%, Thailand 2.4%… [SRC 4]

slides.notes: Thailand is richest per person but has the smallest online audience.

slides.title: We cannot yet say if we can win: app spending, competition and acquisition cost are unknown

ghost.exhibit: table — question × what we know × what is missing, for Indonesia and Vietnam
evidence: [DATA NEEDED] consumer spending on education / language-learning apps by country, US$, latest year, from an app-market data provider; owner: Strategy
[DATA NEEDED] top 5 language-learning apps by downloads and price per country, from app-store rankings; owner: Growth
[DATA NEEDED] share of payments by method (card, e-wallet, carrier billing) per country, from payment-provider reports; owner: Finance
[DATA NEEDED] data-protection and local-entity rules for consumer apps in Indonesia and Vietnam; owner: Legal

slides.notes: Public statistics rank markets; they do not tell us whether this product wins.

slides.title: A six-week paid test in Indonesia and Vietnam answers those questions before full spend

ghost.exhibit: process — localize store page and onboarding → run paid ads in both markets → measure install-to-paid conversion and cost per paying subscriber → decide
evidence: [DATA NEEDED] test budget and full-launch budget, US$, from Finance; owner: CFO
[DATA NEEDED] cost per paying subscriber in Indonesia and Vietnam, US$, from the paid test; owner: Growth

slides.notes: Testing both markets at once also confirms the backup.

slides.title: The Philippines' internet-use rate fell 10.6 points in 2024, so treat its online count with caution

evidence: E14 Philippines internet use: 77.9% (2023) → 67.3% (2024), −10.6 points; 2023 users about 89M [SRC 2]
[DATA NEEDED] reason for the 2024 drop in the Philippines series (method change or real), from the ITU / World Bank series notes; owner: Strategy

slides.notes: Does not change the ranking: on 2023 data the Philippines would have about 89M users, still well below Indonesia.
